info.title: ideogram/ideogram-v4
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "ideogram/ideogram-v4", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Parameters for the Ideogram 4.0 (V4) text-to-image generation proxy request. Supply exactly one of text_prompt or json_prompt.

example.text_prompt: A poster for a jazz festival, bold typography, warm colours

enable_copyright_detection.description: Opt into post-generation copyright detection (Hive likeness and logo checks).

json_prompt.description: Structured V4 prompt. Disables Magic Prompt; consumed directly. Supply exactly one of text_prompt or json_prompt.

text_prompt.description: Natural-language prompt. Enables Magic Prompt automatically. Supply exactly one of text_prompt or json_prompt.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for `ideogram/ideogram-v4`: Ideogram's generate response, forwarded unchanged. The generated images are in `data`, each with its URL at `data[].url`; `data[].is_image_safe` reports Ideogram's own moderation verdict for that image.
`routerresult/classification.go` classifies the `ideogram /ideogram-v4/generate` operation this ID resolves to as direct-return, so `POST /v2/models/ideogram/ideogram-v4` answers this document on the original call. `/proxy/ideogram/ideogram-v4/generate` returns the same document, as it always has.

data.prompt: A poster for a jazz festival, bold typography, warm colours

IdeogramGenerateResponse.description: Response from the Ideogram image generation API.

created.description: Timestamp when the generation was created.

is_image_safe.description: Indicates whether the image is considered safe.

prompt.description: The prompt used to generate this image.

resolution.description: The resolution of the generated image (e.g., '1024x1024').

seed.description: The seed value used for this generation.

style_type.description: The style type used for generation (e.g., 'REALISTIC', 'ANIME').

RenderingSpeed.description: The rendering speed setting that controls the trade-off between generation speed and quality
